proposed_rules.trigger: A '2x1' zone with 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA text plus a '| |' separator, ~453-487px tall, at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the site-wide footer fragment, excluded from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical across every captured page = global chrome, like the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule for the header. Rejected alternative: emit as a per-page 'footer' block (would duplicate identical content on every page).

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node with content matching an FAQ answer appears as a top-level page sibling (e.g. rc4) instead of nested under its question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold it back into the accordion block as the answer for its corresponding question; do not treat as separate content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Artifact of the page-tree capture's overlay-promotion logic, which lifts elements whose rendered box falls outside their DOM parent's bounds.
